[Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cox-s-bazar-refugee-settlement-shelter-footprints-kutupalong-area]
datasets.details: This is a rapid analysis which has not yet been validated in the field. It is important to consider the characteristics of the source imagery used in the analyses when interpreting results. Users with specific questions or concerns should contact reach.mapping@impact-initiatives.org to seek clarification.

lineage.description: Shelter footprints were manually digitized by REACH/UNOSAT analysts from best available satellite imagery acquired in February 2018 of the Kutupalong refugee settlement area in Cox's Bazar District, Bangladesh. The dataset provides spatial inventory of shelter structures as polygon geometries with associated metadata including camp identifiers and settlement classifications.
